decision: Back Tesla (2004) — the pattern the screen was built from

opportunity.subject: electric cars, into an existing global car market
opportunity.notes: A control: the screen should score its own source material highly, and if it does not, the screen is wrong. Scores are the author's reading of the public record.

cost_detached.evidence: Battery packs 'cost $600/kWh and always will'. Priced as constituent metals — cobalt, nickel, aluminium, carbon, polymers — the floor was nearer $80. The canonical gap.

absorbable.evidence: Cells, packs and later large structural castings were all brought in-house rather than bought at someone else's margin.

soft_barrier.evidence: Capital intensity, dealer networks and a century of convention. Every one of them expensive; none of them physics.

existing_need.evidence: Nobody had to be persuaded to want a car. The whole bet was on cost and capability, never on demand.

pulls_help.evidence: Sustainable transport recruited engineers who had better-paid offers. The mission did real work in the labour market.

reachable_proof.evidence: Funded from the PayPal exit, but the Roadster nearly did not make it and 2008 was close to terminal. A 2 here would be hindsight.
